tasks.label: Vérifier DNS, Caddy et services Acer
args: bash -lc 'echo ===HOST===; hostname; echo ===PROJECT===; pwd; ls -l /home/acer/cpvcyclonesviewer/deploy 2>&1; echo ===NODE===; node -v 2>&1; echo ===SERVICES===; systemctl is-enabled cpvcyclones caddy 2>&1; systemctl is-active cpvcyclones caddy 2>&1; echo ===CADDY_CONFIG===; sudo -n cat /etc/caddy/Caddyfile 2>&1; echo ===CADDY_VALIDATE===; sudo -n caddy validate --config /etc/caddy/Caddyfile 2>&1; echo ===APP_UNIT===; sudo -n cat /etc/systemd/system/cpvcyclones.service 2>&1; echo ===PORTS===; ss -ltnup 2>&1; echo ===DNS===; getent ahostsv4 cpvcyclonestv.live; echo ===LOCAL_APP===; curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:8080/ 2>&1; echo ===LOCAL_HTTPS===; curl -sk -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" --resolve cpvcyclonestv.live:443:127.0.0.1 https://cpvcyclonestv.live/ 2>&1'
